trigger: Improve IPC x Fmax after dump-guided bottleneck analysis of the three-entry oldest-ready issue-queue core

files_modified.lines_changed: branch outcome storage, commit-time recovery, and load-dependent memory wakeup control
branch readiness and deferred memory-address wakeup

notes: Branches now execute when ready but redirect and flush only at in-order commit. A load-dependent fixed completion defers only memory-address readiness by one cycle. The 33x33 multiplier is reduced from three cycles to two in RTL, the Verilator model, and Vivado IP configuration. RV32I/M 52/52 passed; srcSmoke 500k IPC is 0.685762; srcWithMext IPC is 0.869596 at 500k and 0.856137 at 20M. Routed WNS is -1.051 ns, equivalent Fmax is 165.26 MHz, and IPC x Fmax is 141.49. All 3875 routed setup-violating endpoints were exported.
